## About

Henry Vu is a machine learning engineer at eXRealityAI in Dallas, where he was the first
engineer, and is finishing an M.Sc. in Computer Science at UT Dallas,
expected Summer 2027. Before that he did a B.Sc. Honors in Computing Science at the University
of Alberta, graduating summa cum laude.

At eXReality he builds the parts of an AI product that decide whether it can be trusted: the
knowledge graph behind a Meta Quest 3 repair app for an automotive pilot, the retrieval layer
that finds the right procedure for a technician's question, and the evaluation harness that
scores it in CI. He also works on inference at the edge, running voice and vision models locally
on NVIDIA Jetson and Apple silicon, and shipped GardenXR to the Meta Horizon Store. On the
research side, he works with Dr. Katherine Brown at UT Dallas on NIH-funded ultrasound
segmentation, getting models small and robust enough to run on portable hardware.

He got into this through math competitions, then research at Amii on online algorithms and
bandits, and over time moved toward the gap between theory and things that actually run.

## Where he has worked

- Founding Machine Learning Engineer, eXRealityAI, Dallas, Aug 2025 to now. Owns XR Auto Service
  (hands-free repair guidance on a headset) and Smart DVI (AI-guided vehicle inspections). Knowledge graph,
  retrieval layer, and CI evaluation harness for a Meta Quest 3 automotive repair app (correct
  procedure ranked first 92 percent of the time on an expert-written test set); a voice-to-voice
  assistant running entirely on NVIDIA Jetson Orin (Whisper, hybrid BM25 and FAISS retrieval,
  quantized Mistral 7B, Kokoro); multimodal XR workflows on Gemini, YOLOv9, and Wit.ai; shipped
  GardenXR to the Meta Horizon Store.
- Computer Vision Engineer, ThorMed Innovation, Dallas, Feb 2025 to now. Modeling lead on an
  NIH-funded project to segment the bladder in clinical ultrasound. U-Net and SimSiam pretraining
  on 9.2K ultrasound images, 96 percent Dice, 4-bit quantization for portable hardware.
- Teaching Assistant, UT Dallas, Jan 2025 to now. Algorithms and data structures.
- Undergraduate Research Assistant, SODALab, University of Alberta, Dec 2023 to May 2024.
  Survey and simulations of multi-armed bandits with Dr. Xiaoqi Tan.
- Teaching Assistant, University of Alberta, Sep 2023 to May 2024. Algorithms and data structures.
- Undergraduate Researcher, Online Learning, Amii, Apr 2022 to May 2023. Online optimization with
  the primal-dual framework and learning-augmented algorithms.

## Projects

- XR Auto Service: hands-free, step-by-step diagnostics and repair guidance for technicians on a
  headset, at eXRealityAI. https://exreality.ai/xr-auto-service.php
- Smart DVI: AI-guided vehicle inspection with hands-free photo and video capture, voice input, and
  an advisor-ready report, at eXRealityAI. https://exreality.ai/smartdvi.php
- DatDai: question answering over Vietnamese land law, live on Cloud Run, with an amendment graph
  and a citation verifier. https://github.com/HenryVu27/DatDai
- ADHD Coaching Agent: LangGraph ReAct agent with guardrail gates, hybrid retrieval, four-tier
  memory, and an evaluation package. https://github.com/HenryVu27/ADHDAgent
- GardenXR: mixed-reality gardening app for Meta Quest on the Meta Horizon Store.
  https://www.meta.com/experiences/gardenxr/24200709416226235/
- Ultrasound Bladder Segmentation: NIH-funded, self-supervised pretraining and 4-bit quantization,
  with a paper. https://github.com/HenryVu27/ThorMed
- ML Interview Practice: browser-only Python practice for ML coding interviews.
  https://henryvu.io/MLInterviewPractice/
- Agentic Framework for Suspect Detection: LangGraph and Gemini multi-agent pipeline.
  https://github.com/HenryVu27/Suspect-Detection
- StitchKit: embroidery digitizing pipeline for a one-person shop, phone-first, in Vietnamese.
- VoiceBridge: real-time Vietnamese-to-Russian speech translation proof of concept.
  https://github.com/HenryVu27/voice-agent
- EEG Decoding, Modeling Political Sarcasm, Multi-armed Bandits and Online Learning, Polyps and
  Breast Ultrasound Segmentation, A Survey of Geometric Set Cover, and earlier coursework.
